note: Common Paper publishes no order form for the SLA. These fields are the substitution points its Standard Terms already name; the labels and hints are ours.

sections.title: Uptime
sections.hint: Leave the target empty and the Standard Terms promise no uptime at all.

fields.label: Target uptime
fields.hint: The availability the provider aims for, measured each calendar month.

fields.label: Uptime credit
fields.hint: What the customer is owed when availability falls short. Service credits are capped at 8% of the fees for the period.
fields.placeholder: 5% of monthly fees for each full percentage point below the Target Uptime

fields.label: Scheduled downtime
fields.hint: Planned maintenance windows, which do not count against uptime.

fields.label: Support channel
fields.hint: Where the customer raises support requests. Response time is measured from arrival here.

fields.label: Target response time
fields.hint: How quickly a support request is acknowledged.

fields.label: Response time credit
fields.hint: What the customer is owed when a request is not acknowledged in time.
fields.placeholder: 2% of monthly fees for each missed acknowledgement

fields.label: Subscription period
fields.hint: The billing term credits are calculated against, taken from the order form this SLA attaches to.
